response.content: {"text":"An onion is a bulbous vegetable composed of multiple layers of fleshy, swollen leaves. It has a papery outer skin that can be white, yellow, or red. The edible layers inside are typically white or translucent and are arranged concentrically around a central core. Onions have a pungent flavor and aroma, which intensifies when cut, and are widely used in cooking for their distinctive taste.","ok":true}
